# Jira connector

> Reads one Jira Cloud project's issues as record streams and carries out three actions on an issue (set_assignee, transition_issue, set_due_date) under the Brain's permits, behind the site's Knovas Link, so that Jira is one connector package of protocol v2 and no change to the Brain, Link, the runner or the Platform.

## Purpose

### Responsible for

| Id | Statement | Code |
|---|---|---|
| `L3-JIRA-CONNECTOR/R-1` | Reading - a project's issues as record messages (fields by field id, computed from the edit metadata and the settings, the parent as the one link), the issue's change-log position as its version, complete generation listings with tombstones, and no report of an absence from a cut listing. | `KnovasConnectorJira/src/knovas_connector_jira/records.py`; `KnovasConnectorJira/src/knovas_connector_jira/adf.py`; `KnovasConnectorJira/src/knovas_connector_jira/connector.py` |
| `L3-JIRA-CONNECTOR/R-2` | The three actions - an exact preview from the edit metadata and the transitions, inexact for a computed field; a direct write only at the expected change-log position, with the permit marker in the same request; a receipt from a re-read; a repeat answered from the marker without a second write. | `KnovasConnectorJira/src/knovas_connector_jira/connector.py` |
| `L3-JIRA-CONNECTOR/R-3` | The calls to Jira - the project from the source's settings, the site's host bound to the credential in the site's environment (the settings' site must name it), the credential in the Authorization header only and only to that host, no redirect followed, rate limits waited out, every failure a code without its text. | `KnovasConnectorJira/src/knovas_connector_jira/client.py` |
| `L3-JIRA-CONNECTOR/R-4` | At a site - registering with Knovas Link as its own component of kind jira with its declaration, the local heartbeat, the command check per source, and Link's jobs probe, preview, act and reread answered through the connector, with the sources and settings Link holds from the Platform and the credential from the site's environment. | `KnovasConnectorJira/src/knovas_connector_jira/site.py` |
| `L3-JIRA-CONNECTOR/R-5` | dump-stream - one complete read of a source as JSON Lines for a mapping run outside the site's loop, with the settings from a file or from Link and the site's credential, written whole or not at all. | `KnovasConnectorJira/src/knovas_connector_jira/dump.py`; `KnovasConnectorJira/src/knovas_connector_jira/__main__.py` |
| `L3-JIRA-CONNECTOR/R-6` | Its image and its place at a site - built from its folder alone with a byte-for-byte copy of the kit, no secret in it, its own user; the site file that adds it beside the Builder's install package. | `KnovasConnectorJira/Dockerfile`; `KnovasConnectorJira/deploy/docker-compose.jira.yml` |

### Not responsible for

- Checking permits; Knovas Link checks them before the connector sees an act (the kit's base class re-checks only that each permit binds its own step).
- Changing a Brain fact; the next read of the project does (GI-CONN-04).
- Choosing the site or the project; both are configuration, not code - the project the source's settings, the site's host the line beside the credential in the site's environment (the founder named the pilot project, D-17).
- Undo, native review and unstage; not in V1 (the founder's decision of 2026-11-10).
- Mapping records onto the Brain; a mapping run reads the stream dump-stream writes (brain-runner's record source), and the Builder has no record mapping yet.

### Terms

- change-log position (the id of an issue's newest change-log entry; the record's version and a permit's expected version)
- permit marker (the issue property knovas.permit.&lt;permit id>, written with the change, by which a repeat finds it)
